result_text:
The landscape contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't add one for a landscape with more contributors than the limit.

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: I removed the `.limit(limit)` from the table stream and deleted the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. The sort order (most recent commits first) is unchanged. This class builds `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, and the bots and teams pages, so all of them now list everyone.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: the bar chart loop now goes over every recently active contributor instead of the first N.

`contributorsListLimit` is still in `LandscapeConfiguration`, but nothing reads it any more. I left `ContributorsReportGenerator.java` alone. It has its own hardcoded 500-row cap, but it is the per-repository report, not the landscape report.
